blocks.text: What Can We Do in and around Kaziranga?
Indulge in an enthralling Jeep Safari

content.text: The Kaziranga National Park is the ultimate place to sight birds, animals, and natural vegetation. You can opt for a jeep safari that will give you a tour around the park, and an escort will accompany you. To witness the wildlife the ideal time for a safari is during the early parts of the day. The main attractions that tourists come to visit are the one-horned rhinos, bears, deer, python, snakebird, jungle fowl, and many more. If you’re lucky enough you may get to see the Bengal florican.

blocks.text: Experience the wildlife by hopping on an elephant for a safari

content.text: The best way to explore the wildlife of Kaziranga National Park is the Elephant Safari. The safari takes around half an hour and the best time is the early mornings of the day. Hop onto an elephant back and enjoy the magnificent and close view of the animals.

Majuli is the largest river island in the world located on the river Brahmaputra. This island has a rich cultural heritage belonging to the Mishing Tribes of Assam. The islanders live a simple and peaceful life which attracts tourists from all around the world who come and spend some time here. You can take part in activities such as cycling and swimming, trek along the forest trails, go fishing on the river, and try the traditional cuisine. The warmth of the people will remind you of home.

Sibsagar is known for its monuments and Ahom Palaces. As of today, it is the major center for the tea and oil industry. The main feature of this place is the water body which is a huge 257-acre tank called the Borpukhuri.

During your visit to the tea plantation, you can watch the aromatic tea being made and also taste a variety of teas there. Located right next to Kaziranga National Park, many of these tea plantations welcome visitors and are open to the public. The most famous tea gardens near the park are the tea gardens of Metoni, Hatkhuli, Difalu, Borchapori, and Behora. The best thing about Kaziranga is that there are several tourist attractions nearby. Tourists can head to this tea plantation for a day during their stay in Kaziranga.

Here are majestic hills, the heights of which arouse awe and reverence in the hearts of travelers who come to see their majestic beauty. Jatinga Valley, where flock of birds come for Harakiri. Ever since the mystery of the birds was revealed here, people’s attention has always been focused on this phenomenon, and the beauty of this valley has been ignored by the mass media in the course of its progress. Without bird mysteries, the Jatinga Valley is still a better destination than many popular destinations in India. The valley is unbelievably beautiful, and on a clear day. It is easy to descend into the valley, where it hits a raging creek at the foot of the hill and icy water. Here, among the rocks, families can spend a day on a picnic with the tranquil mountains and the cool breeze constantly whipping overhead.

Haflong Hill Station, often referred to as White Ant Hill, has a very rich cultural heritage. The largest of many attractions is Haflong Hill, where beautiful scenery fascinates people. It is a place to appeal to nature lovers who can take a walk in the countryside with their loved ones. There is also an ideal place to have a picnic with family and friends. Haflong Lake is another beautiful place that fascinates you. Due to the efforts of the government, the condition of the lake is very good. The tourist attraction of Haflong is Mavon, about 47 km away.

Traveling by road from Jorhat to Kaziranga takes around 2 hours and 21 minutes (111.6 kilometers) via NH715. However, if you want to stop for a cup of tea in the middle of your journey, you can do so at any local tea shop of your choice.
